entities.summary: Dominican Republic is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Santo Domingo. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 11.3 million. Area: 48,671 km². Comprehensive index for the Dominican Republic covering Taíno cacicazgos, Columbus 1492 (Hispaniola, first European colony in Americas), Santo Domingo (first European city), Taíno destruction, colonial sugar/slavery, Haitian occupation 1822-44, Duarte/Trinitarios independence 1844, Santana caudillismo, Haitian-Dominican tensions, Trujillo dictatorship 1930-61 (one of Western Hemisphere's cruelest), 1965 US invasion, Balaguer, baseball culture, and Dominican diaspora.
